verdicts.reason: Both lose the original's colourful ART letterforms: all that is left is a cropped black 'T', some pink stripes and a stray tan bar. The bottom half is mostly dead white space with an orphaned yellow sliver in the corner, so neither reads as the same design. A at least rewraps the headline into clean lines. B keeps the original's forced line breaks, which leaves 'IS' stranded alone on two lines, a ragged, amateur-looking rag and an extra-tall text block.
